title: upfly check --json: the result
description: The last line upfly check --json prints when the check runs. It fails, with exit code 1, when a reference names an image that does not exist, or an image a reference uses is larger than check.maxImageBytes; an unused image never fails it. Progress and diagnostic lines come before it (events.json); a check that cannot run prints an error line instead (events.json).

exitCode.description: 0 when it passed, 1 when a finding failed it.

passed.description: true exactly when findings is empty and exitCode is 0.

maxImageBytes.description: The limit check.maxImageBytes set in the config file, or null when none is set.

changed.description: With --changed: the git ref the change was measured from (null for the uncommitted changes) and how many files it touched. null without --changed.

leftOut.description: Findings --changed left out, since the change did not touch their files. A reference to an image the change deleted is kept wherever it is.

unusedOverLimit.description: Images over the limit that no reference uses. They never fail the check.

unchecked.description: References that could not be checked, since Upfly cannot know which file each names, such as a path built at runtime. upfly audit lists them.

unread.description: Files that could not be parsed or read, so no reference in them was checked. Absent when there are none; upfly audit names them.

fewResolved.description: Present when the folders the site is served from were named, with --public or publicDirs, and under a quarter of the root-relative references resolved in them. If the site is served from there, the rest name no file there: each is among the findings. Without a named folder the check stops instead, with an error line (events.json).

folders.description: The folders named, relative to the project, . being the project itself.

checkable.description: Root-relative references that could be checked: those that resolved and those that name no file.

tooLargeFinding.description: An image a reference uses whose file is larger than check.maxImageBytes.
